name: Thunderwave

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Self 15-foot cube; CON-half Thunder and failed-save 10-foot push; full-contained unsecured objects also pushed; boom audible 300 feet; higher slots scale damage.

rules.text: You unleash a wave of thunderous energy.
Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.
On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the Cube are pushed 10 feet away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 feet.
The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
